sp.name: Umzila wokuhamba
sp.numbers: Konke lapha kuwusizo lokuhlela. Umhlaziyi unquma: umphumela awuyona isitifiketi, umklamo ogunyaziwe noma isitatimende sokuthi isimoto ingasebenzisa noma ayikwazi ukusebenzisa umgwaqo. Ayikho imodeli yokunyakaza, ukubhuleka, isivinini noma ukuziphatha komshayeli; imodelwa ijometri yesivinini esiphansi kuphela.
sp.privacy: Iphrojekthi yakho ihlala kule khompyutha. Akukho lutho oluthunyelwa noma kuphi.
sp.placeholder: Izibalo zesitho sesikhashana ezingakahlolwa. Setha isimoto kusuka esimotweni sokuklama esidingwa ngumthetho wakho (kopisha ngezansi, uhlele) ngaphambi kokuthembela emphumeleni.
sp.veh.help: Isimoto yincazelo emfushane ye-JSON ngamamitha nangamadigri. Shintsha izibalo, bese uyalondoloza: ikopi iyeyakho, iqanjwe ngokuthi my-…, futhi ihlala imakwe njengengakahlolwa kuze uyihlole.
sp.err.nopath: Khetha umzila noma umugqa onamaphoyinti amabili okungenani kuqala.
sp.err.noboundary: Dweba kuqala umugqa ovaliwe wesakhiwo, bese ucindezela Vuselela.
sp.run.help: Imoto yomgwaqo noma isigiya esiphambili sendiza silandela umzila ngeyesi langaphambili; ukubuyela emuva kulandelwa yiyesi lokugcina. Ikhashi lesitimela esilula ligcina amabhoji omabili esitimeleni.
sp.obs.none: Akukho mugqa noma sakhiwo kuphrojekthi okufanele kuhlolwe ngaso.
sp.clr.help: Khetha okungafanele imoto ithinte, setha umkhawulo, bese uhlola ukuhamba kokugcina. Ukungqubuzana ngakunye kuba yinkinga ongaya kuyo.
sp.issue.steer: {v} idinga ikona lokuphendula elingamadigri {value}; umkhawulo wayo: {limit}.
sp.issue.hitch: {v}: ihitch yentelezi iphambi kwe-axle; ithathwa njengaseksele.
sp.rb.help: Dweba isiyingi ngesiyingi, ilane kanye nemilenze yalo, bese uhambisa wonke ama-entry nama-exit wesimoto yomgwaqo ekhethiwe kuwo. Ukunyakaza kuyimizila ebushelelezi; isiqhingi kuphela yisithiyo esihlolwayo.
sp.rb.legs: Izinkomba zemilenze ngamadigri (0 = mpumalanga, ngokuphambene nowashi)
sp.rb.note: Izinkomba zokuphendula ezedlula umkhawulo kanye nokuhamba phezu kwesiqhingi ziyamakwa. Isiyingi futhi sidinga ukuhlola ibanga lokubona nokuphambuka kokungena; lokho akukwenzi.
sp.pk.help: Hlela izindawo zokupaka nendlela ephakathi ngaphakathi komugqa ovaliwe, zibale, bese uhlola ukuthi imoto ekhethiwe ingena kanjani endaweni enzima kunazo zonke uma izimoto ezisendaweni ezeduze zigcwele.
sp.pk.double: Izindawo zokupaka ngaso sombili sendlela ephakathi
sp.pk.nobays: Akukho ndawo yokupaka elingena: yenza isakhiwo sibe sikhulu noma izindawo zokupaka zibe zincane.
sp.pk.fine: Imoto ingena endaweni enzima kunazo zonke ingathinti izimoto ezisemaceleni futhi iphakathi komkhawulo wokuphendula wayo.
sp.pk.trouble: Izindawo zokupaka eziseduze: {n} ziyathintwa; imikhawulo yokuphendula noma yokuphambuka: {p} ifinyelelwe.
sp.pk.note: Indawo enzima kunazo zonke iyeyokugcina emgqeni wokugcina. Umzila uyijika elibushelelezi kusuka endleleni ephakathi; umshayeli wangempela angenza kangcono noma kabi.
